en.name: Lomo embuchado
en.summary: Lomo embuchado is a whole pork loin salted, seasoned with paprika and garlic, stuffed into a casing and air-dried for two to four months. It is one of the leanest cured meats there is. A whole uncut piece hangs for 2–3 months; once cut or opened it keeps 2–3 weeks refrigerated, and 1–2 months frozen. These numbers are read across from sliced hard dry sausage rather than published for lomo.
en.pantry: A whole, uncut caña de lomo hangs in a cool, dry, ventilated place for about 2–3 months. That figure is an extrapolation from dry-cured practice, not a published shelf life. Being very lean, it dries harder and faster than a fatty sausage does — a piece left too long goes from firm to woody rather than becoming unsafe. Keep it away from radiators, out of the sun, and never in a plastic bag, which sweats it.
en.fridge: Once you cut into it, or once a vacuum pack is open, refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it within 2–3 weeks. Because there is so little fat, it dries out visibly within a day or two in a fridge, so press cling film directly onto the cut surface rather than leaving air against it. Slice it thin and let it sit on the plate for a few minutes before eating; straight from the fridge it tastes hard and flat.
en.freezer: A working limit of 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F), and it is not recommended for a whole piece. Sliced and interleaved with baking paper it survives a month or two, but it thaws dry — lean meat has no fat to hide the damage freezing does. Frozen food kept at −18 °C stays safe indefinitely; this is a quality call, not a safety one.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge in its wrapping and eat within a couple of days. Never on the counter, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: A rancid or sharp, solvent-like smell rather than a clean smell of paprika and cured pork.
Slime or tackiness on the casing or on opened slices.
Fuzzy green, grey or black mould as distinct from a dry white bloom.
Slices gone uniformly grey-brown rather than deep red under the paprika coat.
tips: Buy a piece rather than a packet — slices dry out quickly because there is no fat to protect them.
Press film onto the cut face; an air gap is what dries it.
Slice it thinner than you would salami; thick lomo eats tough.
Let the slices warm on the plate for a few minutes before serving.

faq.q: Does lomo embuchado need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: A whole uncut piece can hang in a cool, dry place. Once you cut it or open the pack, refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.

faq.q: How long does lomo keep after opening?
faq.a: About 2–3 weeks refrigerated with the cut face wrapped tight. The figure is borrowed from sliced hard dry sausage.
Sliced, for a month or two, though it thaws dry. Freezing a whole piece is not worth doing.

zh.name: 西班牙風乾豬里肌
zh.summary: Lomo embuchado 是整條豬里肌抹鹽、以紅椒粉和大蒜調味後灌入腸衣、風乾兩到四個月的產品，是最瘦的醃製肉品之一。完整未切開的整條可吊掛 2～3 個月；切開或拆封後冷藏 2～3 週，冷凍 1～2 個月。這些數字是比照「硬式乾香腸切片」讀過來的，不是專為 lomo 公布的。
zh.pantry: 完整未切開的 caña de lomo 吊在陰涼、乾燥、通風的地方，大約 2～3 個月。這個數字是從風乾肉的通則推出來的，不是官方公布的保存期限。因為極瘦，它乾得比肥香腸更快更硬——放太久是從結實變成像木頭，而不是變得不安全。請遠離暖氣和爐火、避免陽光直射，也不要裝塑膠袋悶著。
zh.fridge: 一旦切開，或真空包拆封，就放 4 °C 以下，2～3 週內用完。因為油脂太少，它在冰箱裡一兩天就看得出變乾，所以請把保鮮膜直接壓在切面上，不要留空氣。切薄片，上桌後靜置幾分鐘再吃；剛從冰箱拿出來的口感又硬又沒味道。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下的工作參考值是 1～2 個月，整條冷凍不建議。切片後用烘焙紙隔開可以撐一兩個月，但解凍後很乾——瘦肉沒有油脂可以掩飾冷凍造成的損傷。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，這是品質判斷而非安全問題。
zh.thawing: 維持包裝放冷藏解凍，兩三天內吃完。不要放室溫，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來有油耗味或刺鼻的溶劑味，而不是紅椒與熟成豬肉的乾淨香氣。
腸衣或開封切片發黏、摸起來黏手。
出現綠、灰、黑色絨毛霉（乾燥的白色粉狀霉花則正常）。
切片整片均勻轉灰褐，而不是紅椒衣底下的深紅色。
tips: 買整條不要買切片包——沒有油脂保護，切片乾得很快。
保鮮膜直接壓在切面上；有空隙就是在讓它變乾。
切得比莎樂美腸更薄；厚切的 lomo 咬起來很硬。
上桌前讓切片在盤子上回溫幾分鐘。

faq.q: 西班牙風乾豬里肌需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 完整未切開的可以吊在陰涼乾燥處。一旦切開或拆封，就要放 4 °C 以下冷藏。

faq.q: lomo 開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 冷藏並把切面包緊，約 2～3 週。這個數字是借自硬式乾香腸切片。
切片可以凍一兩個月，但解凍後偏乾。整條冷凍不值得。
